description: This file defines service functions for managing 'Execution' entities, including retrieval, updating, deletion, and fetching public executions, with filtering options and error handling.

methods.name: getExecutionById
methods.description: Fetches an Execution by its ID, optionally filtered by workspace ID, throws error if not found.

methods.name: getPublicExecutionById
methods.description: Fetches a public Execution by its ID, processes executionData to remove credentials.

methods.name: getAllExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Executions with filtering, pagination, and sorting.

methods.name: updateExecution
methods.description: Updates an existing Execution by ID with provided data, optionally filtered by workspace ID.

methods.name: deleteExecutions
methods.description: Deletes multiple Executions by their IDs, optionally filtered by workspace ID, and clears related ChatMessage executionId.
